description: This file defines an abstract class `GrainPersistenceTestsRunner` for running persistence-related tests in an Orleans-based testing environment. The class includes various test methods, utility functions for performance testing, and manages the lifecycle of a test cluster. It serves as a base for implementing specific grain persistence tests.

classes.name: GrainPersistenceTestsRunner
classes.description: An abstract base class for conducting persistence-related tests on Orleans grains, including functional and performance tests, with cluster management and utility functions.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync_Before_WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Clears grain state before the first write, ensuring a clean state for subsequent tests.

methods.name: Grain_GrainStorage_Delete
methods.description: Tests deletion of grain storage and validates state removal.

methods.name: Grain_GrainStorage_Read
methods.description: Verifies reading the initial state of storage grains.

methods.name: Grain_GuidKey_GrainStorage_Read_Write
methods.description: Tests read/write operations on grains identified by GUID keys.

methods.name: Grain_LongKey_GrainStorage_Read_Write
methods.description: Tests read/write operations on grains identified by long keys.

methods.name: Grain_LongKeyExtended_GrainStorage_Read_Write
methods.description: Validates extended key retrieval and storage operations.

methods.name: Grain_GuidKeyExtended_GrainStorage_Read_Write
methods.description: Tests read/write operations with GUID keys and extended string keys.

methods.name: Grain_Generic_GrainStorage_Read_Write
methods.description: Reads and writes generic grain storage data.

methods.name: Grain_NestedGeneric_GrainStorage_Read_Write
methods.description: Tests storage and retrieval of nested generic grain data.

methods.name: Grain_Generic_GrainStorage_DiffTypes
methods.description: Verifies handling of grains with different generic type parameters, including initial state and updates.

methods.name: Grain_GrainStorage_SiloRestart
methods.description: Simulates silo restart and checks persistence of grain state and service ID.

methods.name: Persistence_Perf_Activate
methods.description: Performance test measuring grain activation times.

methods.name: Persistence_Perf_Write
methods.description: Performance test measuring grain write times.

methods.name: Persistence_Perf_Write_Reread
methods.description: Performance test measuring combined write and subsequent read times.

methods.name: Persistence_Silo_StorageProvider
methods.description: Checks whether specific storage providers are correctly configured on silos.
